setlist_extra.title: Phil Lesh and Ned Lagin - Seastones

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): Reviewer notes Bobby playing staccato rhythm on China Cat; Reviewer finds an interesting jam toward the end of China Cat [12][17]
- **Phil Lesh and Ned Lagin - Seastones** (2 reviews): A baby's wail can be heard in Seastones, most active around minutes 3 to 5; Seastones contrasts totally with the first set and is very trippy [15][17]
- **Friend of the Devil** (1 review): Reviewer enjoyed hearing Friend of the Devil in the solid first set [9]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer liked the direction the band was taking Jack Straw in this period [9]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Phil is strong on Let It Grow and the jam is hot [17]
- **Mexicali Blues** (1 review): Audience member near the stage, in front of Bobby, shouted Mexicali after hearing Bobby quietly sound its main chord during tuning [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Phil & Ned**: rare: 14 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-10-17.140588.SBD.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 186 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd74-10-17.sbd.barbella.16189.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 27 songs; 175 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Other One>Spanish Jam>Heaven Help the Fool Jam>Other One, as on the Grateful Dead Movie DVD bonus disc, has phenomenal sound [10]
- **gd1974-10-17.176621.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 26 songs; 192 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1974-10-17.sbd.smith.gems.99032.flac24**: soundboard; 25 songs; 163 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Recording captures the resonant filters in Phil and Ned's set vividly, with intense, heavy playing throughout; Reels remastered for better tonal balance: Phil's bass was reduced and buried highs restored, though still somewhat distant [5][18]
- **gd1974-10-17.sbd.smith.gems.99031.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 163 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [6]. Said about its sound: Clean, clear soundboard; the first song has right-channel trouble that sounds like a blown stage speaker, fixed afterward [12]
- **gd1974-10-17.sbd.royer.10360.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 180 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [7]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Bill Graham [1]
- Relaxed performance in front of the hometown crowd; reviewer wonders whether Jerry played his white Strat [12]
- A big boom during opening Promised Land is said to be Keith's piano top crashing down [15]
- A mic rigged to Bobby's amp stack fell near Billy's kick seconds into Promised Land, causing chirping on all recordings [16]
- The fallen mic stayed there two nights until a roadie found it, affecting both hall mix and 16-track mix [16]
- The Seastones set sat in the middle, making the second Dead set the third set of the night [19]
- Ned Lagin played electric piano and synthesizer on Seastones [3]
- Reviewer calls it the sleeper of the Winterland farewell run; Casey Jones sounds better than on Steal Your Face [9]
- Reviewer calls it the best show of the Winterland run, with the run's single best set [19]
- Reviewer says the movie soundtrack misses much of the best material, as with the rest of the run [19]
- Reviewer sees the band reaching for adventurous playing here, typical of the 1974 sound, which later changed [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-10-17.140588.SBD.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac1644**: taped by From Gastwirt Collection; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Soundboard > 1st gen reel > PCM > DAT; Charlie Miller [1]. Also: Sources include a Maxell UDII reel tape and a multitrack master reel [1]
- **gd74-10-17.sbd.barbella.16189.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1974-10-17.176621.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Louis Falanga; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Louis Falanga's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM 250 mic > Sony TC-110 (Maxell UD C120) [3]. Also: Matt Smith and Jamie Waddell's soundboard patches the first 40 seconds of Seastones, He's Gone's opening, and a 13-second Other One transition [3]
- **gd1974-10-17.sbd.smith.gems.99032.flac24**: transferred by Matt Smith and Jamie Waddell; source: SBD > 16track> 2track for Jerry >? > [5]
- **gd1974-10-17.sbd.smith.gems.99031.flac16**: transferred by Matt Smith and Jamie Waddell; source: SBD > 16track> 2track for Jerry >? > [6]
- **gd1974-10-17.sbd.royer.10360.shnf**: transferred by Carl Royer; source: MSR>DAT>CDR [7]. Also: Uploader's burning note: disc 2 tracks 7-9 go onto disc 3 to match the cover file [7]
